prompt:
A wide office interior at the end of the day. The same man in his mid-thirties, short curly light brown hair with a little volume on top, a neatly trimmed short beard, an athletic build, wearing a light blue button-down shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, stands at a tall window looking out over the city. He is seen from behind and slightly to the side, three quarters, so the viewer reads his posture and a sliver of his profile rather than his full face. He stands in the right half of the frame, one hand in a pocket, relaxed and unhurried.

COMPOSITION, follow this exactly. The whole left half of the picture is window, sky and distant skyline with nothing in front of it, so it stays open and empty. The man stands to the right of centre. His head is about a third of the way down the picture. The floor is a warm ochre plane across the bottom of the frame with his desk chair pushed in at the far right edge.

Behind the window a London skyline of office towers, a dome and two tall construction cranes stands against a flat blue sky with a few flat white clouds. Calm, wide, cinematic composition with generous flat colour areas.

IMPORTANT COLOUR RULE: there is no red anywhere in this picture. No red object, no red accent, no warm red or orange. The cranes are yellow, not red. Use only sky blue, paper white, sand ochre, album yellow, sea green and steel blue.

Ligne claire clear-line comic album illustration. One even unvarying black outline of consistent weight on every single shape. Flat unmodulated colour fills, every area a single solid colour. Absolutely no gradients anywhere, including the sky, which must be one single flat blue from edge to edge. No cast shadows, no shading, no hatching, no stippling, no texture, no photorealism, no 3D rendering. IMPORTANT: no text, no lettering, no words, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks anywhere in the image. No panel border, no black frame, no caption box, no speech balloon, no rounded corners, no letterboxing, no white margin: the illustration bleeds to all four edges of the frame.
